description:
Advanced Modifications

Adds over 20+ Hullmods with dynamic tooltips and combat effects
to expand build possibilities!

Download
(Can be added to existing save!)

Requires:

LazyLib

MagicLib

GraphicsLib

Things to expect:

-High-risk high-reward type modifications.

-Mid combat effects to turn the tides!

-Not just stat change, also custom VFX and special effects!.

-Hullmods with special material requirements.

Spoiler
Materials used to install hullmods are NOT recovered when uninstalling them,
This is intended to force people into thinking twice before making a decision,
however the engine will remember what ship equipped what hullmod (even if destroyed and recovered)
and you will never have to spend materials to reinstall the same hullmod on the same ship again
(This is reflected in the dynamic tooltip before installing the Hullmod)

-Subsystems for upgrading Hullmod effects!

Hullmods:

Spoiler

Subsystems:

Spoiler
Sometimes while salvaging a research or a mining station you might be lucky and find a Subsystem!

These can be installed on ships that already have Advanced Hullmods to unlock their true potential!

Every hullmod supports full dynamic tooltip, when installing a Subsystem,
the tooltip change by listing upgrade effects (if any) and changing all parameters and their colors accordingly

I won't spoil everything here, install the mod and find all possible upgrades yourself!

Balance:

While listening to feedback i learnt that aiming toward perfect balance is simply impossible since everyone wants something,
hence i decided to release this mod as uncompiled source code to give you guys the ability to (change it yourself),
i codded these hullmods to cascade any change in variables to their dynamic tooltips even if you chain upgrade them with a Subsystem.

Changelog:

Spoiler
-v1.2
-Updated mod compatibility for version: 0.98.5a+.
(You can still use updated version of the mod on previous version(s) of the game).

-Added Proton Wall System to the Game.
-Added Flux Shield Matrix to the game.
Added Delta Subsystem upgrade to Flux Shield Matrix.

-Infinity Targeting Core
Fixed a bug with network size calculation for enemy ships.
Fixed a bug that caused smaller ships to go beyond the intended extra range cap from network scaling.
Updated Hullmod tooltip to reflect maximum range bonus attainable via Network scaling across all hullsizes.

-Delta Shield
Fixed a bug that caused shield Arc to be locked incorrectly when used with Delta Subsystem.
Fixed a bug causing the shield to retain improved damage reduction value after removing Delta Subsystem from the ship.

-Crystalized Armor
Damage reduction gained from secondary effect is now multiplicative with other sources.
Added custom VFX color change when used with Delta Subsystem.

-Weapon Control Supercomputer
Fixed compatibility with other Hullmods (opps).

-Combat Analyzer
Increased OP cost on cruisers.
Reduced OP cost Frigates and Destroyers.

-Emergency System
Increased Repair rate (2% --> 3%) when used with Delta subsystem.

-Fixed an exploit that allowed players to invest significantly less item requirements to install hullmods by having 2 cargo stacks of different sizes of the same required item in their inventory.
-Fixed a bug that forced the player to re-invest materials for installing Advanced Hullmods that were already installed on ships recovered from enemy fleets.
-v1.1
-Nanohull:
Fixed a major bug with flux dissipation penalty applying in reverse (opps).

-Crystalized Armor:
Reduced OP cost on smaller ships (Frigates and Destroyers).

Advanced hullmods are now filtered and sorted by tags in the Codex.
Various tooltip optimizations for clarity.
-v1.0
Mod release

Credits:

Big thanks to Spectros and everyone else on the unofficial SS discord whom have provided their feedback
and helped me balance this mod as much as possible!

AI use disclaimer
None of the content featured in this mod is made with AI
